summary: Alphabet Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an offering of 150,000,000 Series B Depositary Shares, each representing a 1/20th interest in a share of Series B Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock with a $1,000 liquidation preference. The mandatory convertible preferred stock pays cumulative dividends and automatically converts into Class C capital stock by May 15, 2029. The filing is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation. It involves no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. What to watch: the offering size, conversion terms, and market reception for the new depositary shares.
